facts.text: Wintersession enrollment is mandatory for all first-year students and undergraduate architecture majors.

sources.title: RISD Wintersession Study Options
sources.quote: All first-year students, undergraduate Architecture majors, and graduate students must enroll in Wintersession. Wintersession enrollment is optional for all other sophomore, junior and senior undergraduate students at RISD.
